WITH mean_incidents AS (
  SELECT 
    neighbourhood_id,
    AVG(occurrence_year) AS mean_year
  FROM incidents
  GROUP BY neighbourhood_id
),
std_dev_incidents AS (
  SELECT 
    neighbourhood_id,
    STDDEV(occurrence_year) AS std_dev_year
  FROM incidents
  GROUP BY neighbourhood_id
),
anomalous_months AS (
  SELECT 
    i.neighbourhood_id,
    i.occurrence_year,
    i.occurrence_month,
    i.occurrence_day,
    i.occurrence_hour,
    i.occurrence_dow,
    i.division,
    i.location_type,
    i.premises_type,
    i.offence,
    i.mci_category,
    i.neighbourhood_id,
    i.longitude,
    i.latitude,
    m.mean_year,
    s.std_dev_year
  FROM incidents i
  JOIN mean_incidents m ON i.neighbourhood_id = m.neighbourhood_id
  JOIN std_dev_incidents s ON i.neighbourhood_id = s.neighbourhood_id
  WHERE i.occurrence_year - m.mean_year > 3 * s.std_dev_year
)
SELECT 
  neighbourhood_id,
  occurrence_year,
  occurrence_month,
  occurrence_day,
  occurrence_hour,
  occurrence_dow,
  division,
  location_type,
  premises_type,
  offence,
  mci_category,
  longitude,
  latitude
FROM anomalous_months

WITH failure_before_success AS (
  SELECT 
    user_name,
    src,
    destination,
    MIN(epoch_time) AS first_failure_time,
    MAX(epoch_time) AS last_failure_time
  FROM 
    auth_events
  WHERE 
    status = 'Failure'
  GROUP BY 
    user_name, src, destination
),
success_after_failure AS (
  SELECT 
    user_name,
    src,
    destination,
    MIN(epoch_time) AS first_success_time,
    MAX(epoch_time) AS last_success_time
  FROM 
    auth_events
  WHERE 
    status = 'Success'
  GROUP BY 
    user_name, src, destination
)
SELECT 
  fbs.user_name,
  fbs.src,
  fbs.destination,
  fbs.first_failure_time,
  fbs.last_failure_time,
  sas.first_success_time,
  sas.last_success_time
FROM 
  failure_before_success fbs
JOIN 
  success_after_failure sas
ON 
  fbs.user_name = sas.user_name
  AND fbs.src = sas.src
  AND fbs.destination = sas.destination
WHERE 
  fbs.last_failure_time < sas.first_success_time
